clips.title: The story
paras: A grim trail begins with Deliah's Ring, found among the Rot Hide gnolls’ corpse piles in Silverpine Forest. Its inscription, “For Deliah,” points back to a plague victim taken from Tirisfal’s mass graves.

Among the gnoll mounds in Silverpine Forest, a ring rests on the pockmarked hand of a relatively fresh corpse. The band bears a simple inscription: “For Deliah.” The Rot Hide gnolls are doing more than scavenging battlefields. They raid the mass graves of Tirisfal Glades and carry human and Forsaken corpses south to Fenris Isle for their own purposes.
